'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Ben Brummett LS Anger, Fear, Aggression''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ben Brummett]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''TRM Podracing'''. Shields 11–12 blank on sheet. Line 40 '''IL-19 (V)''' best-effort from handwriting (uncertain expansion).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
